name: GrowthBook Cloud
description: GrowthBook Cloud provides feature flags, targeting, gradual rollouts, experiments, metrics, and analysis for product teams.
agentUseSummary: Connect a readonly GrowthBook Secret Key bound to one non-production project. Relay approval-gates a first-page feature list and exact feature metadata reads while values, environments, rules, owners, revisions, SDK keys, evaluation, and mutations remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: GROWTHBOOK_CLOUD_READONLY_SECRET_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: GrowthBook Cloud read-only secret API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated GrowthBook Secret Key assigned the readonly role.

credentialRequirements.name: GROWTHBOOK_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: GrowthBook Cloud project ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production project identifier.

capabilities.label: Read feature metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded project-level feature metadata with approval.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Secret API keys and authorization headers never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read values, targeting, or people
blocked.description: Default and rule values, environments, conditions, owners, revisions, creators, custom fields, saved groups, holdouts, SDK keys, and evaluation data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate GrowthBook
blocked.description: Feature, toggle, rollout, environment, project, experiment, metric, member, key, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only first-page project feature list and exact feature GETs run on api.growthbook.io with revisions disabled; arbitrary paths, queries, pagination, evaluation, and self-hosted origins are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both metadata reads require approval; readonly authority, fixed Cloud/project routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and value/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected metadata read runs without Relay approval; readonly authority, fixed Cloud/project routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and value/evaluation/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted readonly key server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.
Railway attaches the encrypted readonly key server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: GrowthBook Cloud requires a customer organization, dedicated readonly Secret Key, and one project. This worker may not create or configure them.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the restricted staging key outside this worker, configure key and project ID in Railway staging, then verify binding, reads, redaction, approvals, bounds, revocation, disconnect, and denial.

evidence.supports: GrowthBook's official generated REST reference pins the Cloud origin, Bearer authentication, readonly Secret Key role, feature list/exact GET routes, pagination and project filters, withRevisions control, response fields, and separate mutations.
GrowthBook publishes the OpenAPI contract behind its generated API reference for fixed operation and schema evidence.
